language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, I'm Chip.
Hello, my name is Seamore and I'm the Park Ranger for this African Wild Park.
We are watering the animals today in the park because it is very hot and they are very thirsty.
Each animal needs a different amount of water. I usually water big animals with a pail. See this pail here?
It can hold 1 liter or 1000 mL. Some animals, like elephants, need more than 1 pail of water.
I usually give elephants 2 pails of water. Smaller animals, like birds, need less than 1 liter.
Half of this pail would be 1/2 liter or 500 milliliters. I usually feed the birds just 10 milliliters of water.
Before we water the animals, why don't you join me for breakfast? You can see how the liter is used to measure everyday objects.
I'm here to give you helpful tips and reminders. 1 liter can also be written as 1L and 1 milliliter is written as 1mL. Remember 1000 mL = 1L and 500 mL = 1/2  of a liter.
